venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.notes_summary: Nice Saturday at CC ATL. Nice pop at open with FOH welcoming early flow. Opener left around 9pm, then another wave of guests brought energy. Investors and regulars stopped by. Scholarship gala guests trickled in around 10pm — all fans of the espresso martini, ~10 at the table. BOH handled tickets timely. Smooth EON with closer leaving around 1am. Lots of familiar faces in the house.

highlights.text: Scholarship gala guests trickled in around 10pm; investors and regulars visited

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.notes_summary: Not super busy but solid. Guests catching on about plastic cups for outside — telling guests is paying off for spring/fall months. Fishmonger and Charmers sent boomerangs and CC reciprocated — whole building felt like a cohesive element.

highlights.text: Plastic cups for outdoor sipping gaining traction; great neighbor energy with Fishmonger & Charmers

venues.name: Municipal Grand
venues.notes_summary: Strong Saturday morning from 8am, busiest 10am-2pm. Emphasis on guests heading to Sun Club. PM reservations took hold after 6pm, big food push at 7pm — kitchen crushed it. After 8:30pm MB emptied out due to events in town. Big push for last-call drinks. Sun Club very busy with 100% pool occupancy. Hot Eye had solid pop from the start, shoulder-to-shoulder at 11:30pm with wedding parties, locals, and Billy Strings fans. No sendbacks or DNLs from kitchen.

highlights.text: Sun Club 100% pool occupancy; Hot Eye shoulder-to-shoulder with wedding parties & Billy Strings fans
Big events in town pulled guests out early evening; strong morning and late-night energy

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.notes_summary: Very steady Saturday despite Coachella weekend in the city — didn't seem to affect D&C much. Busy first couple hours with lots of walk-ins. Short a server so Angel moved from bar back to server — team filled holes well. Decent waitlist most of the night with lots of large parties; team did great burning and turning. Rain around midnight slowed walk-in pace for a smooth ending. No-shows were charged.

highlights.text: Strong performance despite Coachella weekend; team adapted well to being short-staffed

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.notes_summary: Slower night than last Saturday but lots of groups stayed long and continuously enjoyed. Slightly higher food sales & happy guests. Garden had tight turns and clever host maneuvering — multiple parties at 621 high top mentioned unstable chairs. Kitchen had great night with Archer & Isaias — food orders all the way to end. AM sales solid with Care Leite. Recognized as city's best sober bar two years running. Nik's last day approaching.
maintenance_flags: 621 high top chairs feel unstable per multiple guest mentions

highlights.text: 621 high top chairs unstable — multiple guest complaints
Recognized as city's best sober bar two years running; made food for an NFL player

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.notes_summary: Flip-flopping between half-full and overfull all night. Second turn mighty busy with >1k in one section alone. Nice refilling after 1am. Large parties dominated with 5 large parties, 13 solos, 10 investor cocktails. Warm night brought friend groups and large walk-up parties. Wait grew after 10pm, completed around 12:30am. Welcomed Nicole Pla from D&C Denver, Kenneth Young from Joyface, and D&C members. Top sellers: Masari, Spaaaace, City Point, Buckhorn Exchange.

highlights.text: Big Saturday energy — 5 large parties, 13 solos, warm weather brought crowds past 1am

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.notes_summary: Solid night. Garden benefited from warm weather — guests opted to sit outside including some scheduled reservations. Marquee had waves of filling and emptying; late cancellations and no-shows affected pacing. Jordan continued training alongside Grant and Devan — extra hands sped up service but communication needs tightening. Big night for B-side cocktails, especially Cafe Del Tigre. Late wave at 11pm filled marquee quickly, guests sat until 1am but room empty by 2:15. Kitchen busy with 16% food sales. Garden last-called at midnight, moved remaining wait inside.

highlights.text: Garden popping — finally looking like Spring in DC!
B-side cocktails big night; Jordan training progressing; communication on floor needs work
